title: Pop Star Inas X Dazzles with Wild New Visuals For 'Maniac,' Ahead of Debut Album | User | minstercommunitypost.com
text:
From lover girl to her untamed alter ego, Inas X returns with wild new visuals for her song ‘Maniac.'
LOS ANGELES, CA / ACCESS Newswire / April 23, 2025 / Pop singer-songwriter Inas X unleashes her wild side in the stunning visuals for her new single " Maniac ." This bold release follows a trail of hit songs, building anticipation for her debut album. With a sultry performance that highlights her lover girl alter ego, " Maniac" is a powerful declaration of Inas X's lyrical mastery in pop and R&B.
From her chart-topping Billboard songs, like " Love Is " and " Stupid " featuring the late PnB Rock , to her glam switch-ups and sizzling hot looks, Inas X is an unstoppable force and phenomenon of internet fame. Her recent single " Lovergirl " has become an anthem for hopeless romantics, resonating with millions of fans worldwide.
The Brooklyn native blends R&B, pop, hip-hop, and Middle Eastern influences to create a powerful, genre-defying sound that is both infectious and unique. This year, she is stepping into her full power, both musically and creatively, aiming to redefine the music landscape. By fusing cultures, sounds, and untold stories, Inas X perfectly captures the vibe for this hot and icy girl season.
"Maniac is about owning your power. Your sexy side, your crazy side, your needy side, etc; all the sides you might be made to feel shameful about as a woman," states Inas X. " It's about owning your dark and divine feminine energy because it makes you who you are. It makes me who I am. So, let's just be women and own our sides, unapologetically."
For your next new music and/or artist spotlight, consider Inas X and her new single "Maniac."
LISTEN TO ‘MANIAC'
ABOUT INAS X:
Inas X isn't just an artist - she's a cultural phenomenon, blending her rich Palestinian roots with the pulsating rhythms of R&B and Pop. Hailing from the vibrant streets of Brooklyn, Inas X has carved out a unique space in the music industry, captivating audiences worldwide with her soulful vocals and empowering lyrics.
Her hit singles, including " Goddess " and " Goddess Remix ," have consistently topped Spotify, iTunes, and Apple Music charts, while "Love Is" reached No. 12 on Billboard's Dance charts. Collaborations like " Stupid " featuring the late rap artist PnB Rock showcase her versatility and appeal across genres. Beyond her chart success, Inas X's music is a celebration of womanhood, culture, empowerment, and pride.
